## Appearance

Aunt Jamesina is a tiny old woman featuring a small, softly-triangular face with large, soft blue eyes and pink cheeks. Her snow-white hair is styled in quaint little puffs over her ears, and she wears old-fashioned clothes.

_Sources: [v3 ch.Relationships P52](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0052), [v3 ch.Relationships P53](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0053)_

## Personality

Described as the sweetest aunt who possesses mirthful eyes, she holds an old-fashioned worldview that matches her attire and maintains a proper respect for the clergy. Her personal aspiration for the afterlife is to obtain a yellow silk dress.

_Sources: [v3 ch.Friend P13](../source/v03-c09.md#nw-v03-c09-p0013), [v3 ch.Relationships P53](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0053), [v3 ch.Anne-girl P2](../source/v03-c18.md#nw-v03-c18-p0002), [v3 ch.Interlude P6](../source/v03-c19.md#nw-v03-c19-p0006), [v3 ch.B.A.’s P42](../source/v03-c37.md#nw-v03-c37-p0042)_

## History

Aunt Jamesina was named after her father, [James](../character/james-a.md), who drowned at sea shortly before her birth. Throughout her life, her mother and husband prevented her from owning a yellow silk dress, and she eventually raised a daughter whom she taught to cook before sending her to college. Later in life, she accepted a cat named [Sarah](../character/sarah.md) from her washerwoman and took up residence at Patty's Place along with [Sarah](../character/sarah.md) and another cat named [Joseph](../character/joseph.md) to chaperone [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) and her college friends. During her time living at Patty's Place, she maintained a relaxed attitude toward the girls' independence, managed household chats, and shared her humorous views on life and suitors. Over the next four years, she remained at the house, sharing stories and laughs with the girls as they completed their studies at [Redmond College](../codex/places.md#redmond-college) up until their graduation.

_Sources: [v3 ch.Friend P13](../source/v03-c09.md#nw-v03-c09-p0013), [v3 ch.Relationships P0](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0000), [v3 ch.Relationships P2](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0002), [v3 ch.Relationships P44](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0044), [v3 ch.Relationships P53](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0053), [v3 ch.Relationships P58](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0058), +16 more_

## Quotes

> "Kittens have to be drowned, I admit, or the world would be overrun. But no decent, grown-up cat should be done to death—unless he sucks eggs."
>
> — Aunt Jamesina — [v3 ch.Relationships P69](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0069)

> "Well, I hope so, Anne. I do hope so, because I love her. But I can’t understand her—she beats me. She isn’t like any of the girls I ever knew, or any of the girls I was myself."
>
> — Aunt Jamesina — [v3 ch.Interlude P40](../source/v03-c19.md#nw-v03-c19-p0040)

> "Yes, in my soul. But I’ll admit my legs aren’t as young as yours. You go and get some fresh air, Anne. You look pale lately."
>
> — Aunt Jamesina — [v3 ch.Charming P4](../source/v03-c25.md#nw-v03-c25-p0004)

> "Anybody is liable to rheumatism in her legs, Anne. It’s only old people who should have rheumatism in their souls, though. Thank goodness, I never have. When you get rheumatism in your soul you might as well go and pick out your coffin."
>
> — Aunt Jamesina — [v3 ch.Charming P10](../source/v03-c25.md#nw-v03-c25-p0010)

> "I’ve got them yet. There are three old widowers at home who have been casting sheep’s eyes at me for some time. You children needn’t think you own all the romance in the world."
>
> — Aunt Jamesina — [v3 ch.Opens P23](../source/v03-c35.md#nw-v03-c35-p0023)

### [Roy Gardner](../character/roy-gardner.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/aunt-jamesina--roy-gardner.md)
